item.title: Glucosamine supplement tied to faster Alzheimer's progression
item.description: A large health-record analysis found glucosamine use was linked to a 25% higher likelihood of mild cognitive impairment progressing to dementia.

item.title: Why rheumatoid arthritis pain can persist despite controlled inflammation
item.description: Pain and fatigue in rheumatoid arthritis can persist even after inflammation improves, with depression, poor sleep, obesity, smoking, and chronic pain contributing.
